name: Carry Forward Unleashed
author: MasterRDF
description: Modern Warfare II and III guns in Black Ops 7 menus, loadouts and Zombies: the Mystery Box Loadout menu (choose which games the box gives), weapon lists grouped by game, Pack-a-Punch, BO7-style Zombies ammo and loadout guns in Zombies. Needs hid.dll (loader 3) in the cod25 folder, which loads this folder's mw2_guns.dll. Switching the mod on or off takes full effect after restarting the game. Logs: kronos\Logs\mw2_guns*.log.
